name: Manchester City FC
desc: Manchester City FC is a Premier League football club and one of the most successful clubs in English football. Based at the Etihad Stadium, the club operates as part of the City Football Group and manages complex multi-entity financial operations across its global portfolio.
whoText: Manchester City FC is a founding member of the Premier League and part of City Football Group, one of the world's largest multi-club football ownership groups. The club has won multiple league titles and operates a world-class training and stadium facility in east Manchester.

krs.text: Consolidated multi-entity financials across City Football Group within a single platform
Eliminated manual Excel-based reporting and reduced risk of version errors
Delivered real-time budget tracking for both football operations and commercial divisions

results: Reduced close cycle from ~3 weeks to under 1 week
Board pack preparation time cut by more than half

data.label: Business Challange
data.heading: From spreadsheets to a single source of truth
data.body:
Manchester City FC's finance team was managing budgets and forecasts across multiple entities using disconnected spreadsheets. With operations spanning football, commercial, and academy divisions, version control was a constant challenge and month-end close was time-consuming.
Prophix gave the team a centralised platform to manage all entities in one place, with role-based access and a structured close process.
- good client
- good team
- new client

data.title: Sarah Thompson, Head of Finance
data.quote: Before Prophix, month-end was a scramble across dozens of spreadsheets. Now we close with confidence, and leadership can see exactly where we are — in real time.

data.heading: Faster, more confident board reporting
data.body:
With Prophix, the finance team now produces board packs in a fraction of the time. Automated consolidation and pre-built report templates mean the team spends less time on data wrangling and more time on analysis.
Leadership now has instant access to actuals vs. budget across all departments — giving them the visibility they need to make decisions quickly.
